stories.title: The Rays brought out the best in Freddy Peralta -- now he can pitch them into the World Series
stories.summary: After his disastrous stint with the Mets, the Rays took a risk on the two-time All-Star. Tampa Bay has been rewarded with an ace turnaround.

stories.title: 'I was ecstatic': How bold trade deadline transformed Guardians' season
stories.summary: Here's how a rare go-for-it approach in August has Cleveland playing deep into October.

stories.title: Sources: Hurts to miss season after blood clots discovered in QB's lungs
stories.summary: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season after doctors discovered multiple blood clots in his lungs, according to NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: Bills' Gardner-Johnson suspended one game for spitting at Raiders players
stories.summary: The NFL has suspended Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson for one game after cameras captured him spitting toward Raiders players on Sunday.

stories.title: Colts fire GM Ballard after home loss to Titans, cite 'necessary' change
stories.summary: The Colts fired GM Chris Ballard one day after losing to the previously winless Titans. Owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon said "a change in leadership is necessary."
